description: 上流の利用状況モデリング（ドメイン分析 → ペルソナ立案 → ユーザーストーリーマップ5階層 → テスト要求導出）を二層構成で支援する。決定的層は、アクティビティ/タスク/ストーリー/テスト要求のID重複・欠番・プレフィックス不一致・階層参照の未解決・ストーリー未紐づけペルソナ・テスト要求0件ペルソナ・ペルソナ4象限の未記入・テスト要求行(現状/将来/テスト要求)の欠落・ドメイン分析観点の被覆状況に加えて、ステークホルダー2軸評価（影響力×関心度）の未評価軸・範囲外値・宣言扱いクラスと matrix 対応の不一致・評価根拠の未記入・重点クラスのテスト要求0件を検査する。意味的層は、フレームの質問例に基づく深掘り指示のみを呼び出し側LLMへ返す。activities / tasks / stories / testRequirements が未指定・空の場合は生成指示のみを返し、既存成果物を渡せばレビューとして機能する。導出したテスト要求は source="stakeholder" のテスト条件として extract_test_conditions へ引き渡す。

activities.description: Activity level of the story map; omitted or empty triggers generation-instruction-only mode

personaIds.description: Persona ids this activity belongs to

productGoal.description: Product goal this activity contributes to

completedTools.description: Already executed tools; entries without evidence are treated as not executed

evidence.description: Evidence of execution: an output file path (e.g. docs/test-cases.md) or an output heading line starting with '#'

outputExcerpt.description: Excerpt of the declared tool's actual output text. Must contain that tool's own H1 heading line; otherwise the declaration is reported as evidence-unverified and still counted as not executed

toolName.description: Name of an already executed tool in this workflow

domainAnalysis.description: Domain analysis findings per aspect id (persona-journey-frame domainAnalysisAspects)

aspectId.description: Domain analysis aspect id from the frame, e.g. DOM-01

idPrefixes.description: Id prefixes used for duplicate / gap / prefix-mismatch detection

personas.description: Personas described with the Demographics / Says&Thinks / Goals / PainPoint quadrants; handed over to extract_test_conditions as-is

concerns.description: Known concerns of this persona (legacy field; prefer painPoints)

demographics.description: Demographics quadrant: age range, occupation, usage environment, IT literacy, etc.

goals.description: Goals quadrant: what this persona wants to achieve

id.description: Persona id referenced by activities / stories / test requirements

painPoints.description: Pain Point quadrant: frustrations and obstacles this persona faces

saysAndThinks.description: Says & Thinks quadrant: what this persona says and thinks in the target context

stakeholderWeighting.description: Stakeholder weighting (influence x interest) result from the persona journey frame

excludedByScreening.description: Whether this stakeholder was screened out in SWS-04

exclusionReason.description: Reason for screening out; required when excludedByScreening is true

handlingClassId.description: Declared handling class id (SWC-01..SWC-03); cross-checked against the frame matrix

influence.description: Influence axis value taken from the frame levels (SW-INFLUENCE); omit when unevaluated

interest.description: Interest axis value taken from the frame levels (SW-INTEREST); omit when unevaluated

rationale.description: Facts backing the chosen axis values (at least one required)

score.description: Declared stakeholderScore; cross-checked against influence x interest

stories.description: User story level of the story map

personaIds.description: Persona ids this story belongs to

tasks.description: Task level of the story map

testRequirements.description: Test requirements derived from the before/after delta; handed over as source=stakeholder conditions

after.description: Future state (After): what success looks like

before.description: Current state (Before): how the persona struggles today

personaId.description: Persona id this test requirement was derived from

testRequirement.description: What testing must confirm about the before/after delta

name: generate_user_story_map
title: Generate User Story Map
